authorityNote: PitchMind project convention based on the user-provided 18-region descriptions; not official FIFA or IFAB numbered zones.

orientation.width: attacking team left to right as viewed by a player facing the opponent goal
orientation.numbering: six increasing length bands; each band numbered left, central, right

geometryPolicy.coordinateSemantics: unverified for candidate MANU-LIV synthetic feed
geometryPolicy.cutLines: Do not assume equal metres or normalized percentages. Define and version in an approved coordinate manifest before classifying points.
geometryPolicy.formalMarkings: IFAB penalty/goal area, penalty mark/arc, goalmouth, and corner-area geometry are separately calibrated overlays; Zone 14/17 labels do not replace legal polygons.

zones.name: Deep defensive left
zones.tacticalMeaning: Primary left-back defensive territory to contain the opposing wide attacker; can also support a safer first build-up along the touchline.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Deep defensive center
zones.tacticalMeaning: Central area directly in front of the team's own goal. Prioritize goal protection, secure clearance, or low-risk build-up involving centre-backs and goalkeeper.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Deep defensive right
zones.tacticalMeaning: Primary right-back defensive territory to contain the opposing left-sided attacker and limit delivery from that side.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Defensive midfield left
zones.tacticalMeaning: Left-sided transition outlet for a full-back or dropping midfielder to escape central pressure and advance possession.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Defensive midfield center
zones.tacticalMeaning: Potential number-six anchor and screen in front of centre-backs; can disrupt central counters and offer a first central outlet.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Defensive midfield right
zones.tacticalMeaning: Right-sided transition outlet that can widen the first build-up and stretch the opponent's initial press.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Central midfield left
zones.tacticalMeaning: Left central-midfield transition area where a winger may link deeper or a progressive midfielder may carry play forward.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Central midfield center
zones.tacticalMeaning: Central circulation area for tempo control, connecting defence to attack, and switching play toward either flank.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Central midfield right
zones.tacticalMeaning: Right central-midfield circulation area for retaining possession and changing the angle of attack.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Attacking midfield left
zones.tacticalMeaning: Left half-space entry reference where an inverted winger or attacking midfielder may receive between the opposing full-back and centre-back.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Attacking midfield center
zones.tacticalMeaning: Central link pocket for receiving on the half-turn and connecting deeper midfield to the final attacking line.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Attacking midfield right
zones.tacticalMeaning: Right half-space entry reference where a creative player may receive between the opposing full-back and centre-back and connect into the box.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: High attacking left
zones.tacticalMeaning: Wide creative area for an overlapping full-back or winger to deliver a cross or cutback; can also support an inside run.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: High attacking center (Zone 14 reference)
zones.tacticalMeaning: Central creative pocket immediately outside the opposition penalty area. A receiver may draw a centre-back forward and create space behind, depending on defensive cover and movement.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: High attacking right
zones.tacticalMeaning: Wide creative area for a winger to isolate a defender, cut inside where suitable, or for a full-back to deliver toward the far post.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Deep attacking left
zones.tacticalMeaning: Left byline/corner-side area used to pin the defence deep, seek a restart, or deliver a low cross/cutback across goal.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Deep attacking center (Zone 17 reference)
zones.tacticalMeaning: Central penalty-box reference where attackers may time runs and defenders protect goal-facing space. The legal penalty-area polygon is a separate calibrated overlay; no goal-frequency claim is implied.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

zones.name: Deep attacking right
zones.tacticalMeaning: Right byline/corner-side area used to pin the defence deep, seek a restart, or deliver a low cross/cutback across goal.
zones.interpretationLimit: A zone label is location vocabulary; it does not alone establish role, pressure, danger, intent, advantage, or outcome.

tacticalTransitionNote: If a defender is advanced when possession is lost, the space behind may be exposed. Whether the defender can recover depends on the counter carrier/action, pressure, recovery route, goal-side position, centre-back/pivot/far-side cover, and goalkeeper depth. Treat this as a conditional risk hypothesis; the advanced zone alone does not prove error, inability to recover, or a clear chance.
